description: React component for transforming API requests into curl commands within a UI panel, including request editing, transformation logic, and display of the resulting curl command.

classes.name: TransformRequestPanelProps
classes.description: Props interface for the TransformRequestPanel component, including optional accessToken.

classes.name: TransformResponse
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of the API response containing request parts.

methods.name: formatCurlCommand
methods.description: Formats API request parts into a curl command string with proper indentation.

methods.name: handleTransform
methods.description: Handles the transformation process: parsing JSON, calling API, and updating UI with curl command.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl + Enter) to trigger request transformation.
